method valid_date(date: string) returns (result: bool)
    requires date != ""
    requires date.Length == 10
    requires date[2] == '-' && date[5] == '-'
    requires date[0..2] in "0123456789" && date[3..5] in "0123456789" && date[6..10] in "0123456789"
    ensures result == (exists m, d, y :: 
        m == Convert.ToInt32(date[0..2]) &&
        d == Convert.ToInt32(date[3..5]) &&
        y == Convert.ToInt32(date[6..10]) &&
        (1 <= m && m <= 12) && 
        (1 <= d && d <= 
            (if m == 2 then 29 
             else if m in [4, 6, 9, 11] then 30 
             else 31)))
    ensures !result == (forall m, d, y ::
        m == Convert.ToInt32(date[0..2]) &&
        d == Convert.ToInt32(date[3..5]) &&
        y == Convert.ToInt32(date[6..10]) &&
        (m < 1 || m > 12 || 
         (m == 2 && (d < 1 || d > 29)) || 
         (m in [4, 6, 9, 11] && (d < 1 || d > 30)) || 
         (d < 1 || d > 31)))
```
